resources.string: Let AI apps read your data while you allow it
Pro · Let AI apps read your data while you allow it

Ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI app about your spending, or open the dashboard on a computer. They can read your transactions, balances and subscriptions only while an AI session is on. They can\'t change anything.
AI access is a Pro feature.
Off. Start one before you ask, or use the PennyWise AI tile in Quick Settings.
1. In Claude or ChatGPT, add a custom connector with this URL:
2. When it asks you to sign in, enter a pairing code from here.
Detailed analytics and your full history on a bigger screen. Open this address on a computer, then connect with a pairing code:

Your data stays on your phone. During an AI session, the AI app\'s questions pass through the relay to your phone and the answers go back the same way. The relay never stores or logs them. The AI app\'s provider (for example Anthropic or OpenAI) sees the answers it receives.\n\nConnected apps can search your whole history across all profiles, including payee names on transfers. They never get SMS text, full account numbers or reference numbers.
For full control, deploy the open-source relay (relay/ in PennyWise\'s GitHub repository) to your own Cloudflare account and enter its address. Switching relays disconnects every AI app.
Stop the AI session before changing the relay.
Enter an https:// address, for example https://relay.example.com
Relay changed. Connect your AI apps again.
Every connected AI app loses access. To use one again, connect it with a new pairing code.
Couldn\'t reach the relay. Check your internet connection and try again.
